blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-08-10 across all four deployments. EVM (Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum, 0x86856814e74456893cfc8946bedcbb472b5fa856): the verified Ethereum Token source is OpenZeppelin ERC20+Ownable+ERC20Permit with stock transfer/transferFrom, no blacklist, freeze, pause, or seize path; burn1-burn4 burn only msg.sender for the ICP bridge route; onlyOwner covers mint/batchMint/withdrawEth/updateMinAmount/updateOwner, and owner() read at Ethereum block 25648434 returned the bridge operator 0x70AE25592209B57F62b3a3e832ab356228a2192C, so owner reach is mint-only and never holder-burn; the 2026-07-20 bridge-route review verified the identical function set on Base and Arbitrum (a 2026-07-30 Base source re-check was unavailable, explorer error). Canonical ICP ledger 6c7su-kiaaa-aaaar-qaira-cai: Gold DAO's dfx.json pins the stock DFINITY ICRC-1 ledger-suite wasm and candid (dfinity/ic commit 75dd48c), whose current interface exposes only ICRC-1/2/3/21 methods with no freeze, blacklist, block-account, or pause entrypoint; a live on-chain standards query on 2026-07-30 returned exactly ICRC-1/2/3/21, and the ICRC API shows the sole minting account is the GLDT swap canister. However, the canonical ledger controller is Gold DAO SNS root tw2vt-hqaaa-aaaaq-aab6a-cai, and the transfer-review overlay establishes that this controller can install replacement ledger Wasm and change holder-transfer behavior behind live balances. That mutable holder-transfer surface is direct Possible FreezeWatch exposure even though no current deployment exposes an active holder-targeted blacklist or freeze entrypoint. The earlier untracked-upstream signal remains suppressed as a same-symbol/text false positive: GLDT's backing is locked GLD NFTs over physical gold, not a tracked freezable upstream stablecoin.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GLDT is native to the Internet Computer (ledger minting account = SNS-controlled GLDT swap canister, verified via IC APIs 2026-07-20). Its Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum deployments are a custom Ownable lock-mint bridge token operated by a single bridge-operator EOA (attributed to Omnity Network, which officially lists GLDT for ICP-to-EVM routes); EVM footprint is tiny.
